The positional encoding layer maintains a frequency index $k$ ranging from $0$ to $L-1$.
The filter state is defined by the current active frequency threshold, determined by the ratio $\alpha$ and the initial offset $\alpha_0$.
Calculate the weight $\omega_k(\alpha)$ to determine if the band is active.
If $\alpha$ approaches 1, the threshold approaches $(1 + \alpha_0)L$, which exceeds $L$.
